findings.highlight: to say nothing of the castle
findings.evidenceJa: 城門にさえ見張りがいない
findings.governingReading: 城門 specifies unguarded gate in addition to walls, separate from building route.
findings.explanation: Castle gate becomes castle itself again.

findings.highlight: this enemy is not so easily approached.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな悠長な真似が通じる相手ではなかろう
findings.governingReading: 悠長な真似 rejects slow waterway infiltration against this opponent, then direct rescue because detection certain.
findings.explanation: A leisurely route cannot work becomes enemy not easily approached.

findings.governingReading: 何やら思案する is considering while gazing up; subsequent gaze careful.

findings.highlight: He isn't going very fast, but his ascent is sure and steady.
findings.evidenceJa: その姿はだからこそズッシリとした安定感があった。
findings.governingReading: だからこそ makes slow pace cause/emphasis of reassuring heaviness/stability.
findings.explanation: Slow and therefore stable becomes slow but stable.

findings.highlight: all I can do is try to imitate Kotomine.
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰を寸分たがわず真似するしかなかった。
findings.governingReading: Lacking climbing experience, Shirou must copy Kotomine without deviation.
findings.explanation: The explicit requirement to copy Kotomine exactly is reduced, though the next sentence preserves the danger of a slight mistake. This does not support the proposed character dossier.

findings.highlight: I cautiously scout out the thinnest of lips or crevices I can use to support my entire body weight.
findings.evidenceJa: 体重を預けて、これまた爪先ほどもない足場で体を固定する。
findings.governingReading: それだけの手掛かりに体重を預け…足場で体を固定 describes actual bearing weight and anchoring with undersized footholds.
findings.explanation: Weight on finger holds and body fixed with tiny footholds becomes scouting holds.

findings.highlight: a climb only an expert could do
findings.evidenceJa: よっぽど隅々まで鍛えてないと
findings.governingReading: 隅々まで鍛えて is conditioning every body part to keep up physically.
findings.explanation: Every part of body trained becomes only expert skill.

findings.highlight: most of my body was already falling.
findings.evidenceJa: 体はほとんど落下していた。
findings.governingReading: 体はほとんど落下していた modifies degree/state of falling, not fraction of body.
findings.explanation: Body almost falling becomes most body falling.

findings.governingReading: 瞬間 marks trigger when Illya calls and all trifles disappear.
findings.explanation: At that instant becomes for an instant.

findings.highlight: You're the one who needs to apologize
findings.evidenceJa: 許さないのはこっちだ
findings.governingReading: 許さないのはこっちだ repeats her refusal-to-forgive in reversal of speaker.
findings.explanation: I will not forgive becomes you need to apologize.

findings.highlight: I'm here because I want to be.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしは嫌だなんて思ってないわ。
findings.governingReading: 嫌だなんて思ってない denies objection, then explains created function and unwanted key role.
findings.explanation: Not disliking role becomes positively wanting to be here.
